body:
Nina: Need a quick customer snapshot for Lumina — short blog (<=250w), 30s social, and a demo CTA. Can we squeeze this into next week?
Omar: I can record Tue 9-9:30am PT. Will ask 3 focused Qs (pain, impact, one-liner).
Hannah: Tue 9 works for the customer. Please share Qs + a one-line release in advance.
Omar: Draft Qs: 1) What challenge were you solving? 2) What measurable difference did Redwood make? 3) One short quote we can tweet.
Priya: Legal: we require explicit permission for quote + logo. If they include metrics, get signed email approval. Add a checkbox in prep doc.
Sam: Sales routing: tag SFDC with `Case: LUMINA-SNAP-2026` and add 15-min demo CTA. Also route EU clicks to EU SDR queue.
Nina: I'll add the release text to the prep doc and export a signed PDF after they reply. Action owners: Nina (prep + publish), Omar (record + edit), Priya (store approval), Sam (SFDC rule).
PublishBot: Calendar event created: Lumina snapshot recording Tue 09:00-09:30 PT (Nina, Omar, Hannah, Customer Rep).
Omar: Will upload draft transcript and two quote variants (numbers vs qualitative) and ping the customer for one-line approval.
Priya: If numbers are included, ensure the approval email states the exact phrasing. Otherwise we'll default to "significantly reduced latency and costs."
Nina: Timeline: record Tue, edit Tue afternoon, legal signoff Wed morning, publish next Tue. OK?
Sam: Yep. I'll prepare the SFDC routing rule and demo CTA before publish.
Nina: Great — small sprint. I'll post assets here when ready. :rocket:
